attributes.title: alarm_shelve
attributes.description: Shelve Alarms at exact Alarm paths via system.alarm.shelve, for an explicit duration in seconds. Wildcard targets are forbidden (D12), so every path must be provider-qualified with no *: a pattern without * matches only the source it spells out, which is what keeps a shelve from widening to a subtree. timeoutSeconds is required, minimum 1, hard maximum 86400; the Runtime Target Policy may lower that cap through alarmShelveMaxSeconds and never raise it. The result's Observed state is the alarm_shelved_list view of the exact paths and never decides success. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a path outside the alarm_shelve Target allowlist, or one that names the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), fails with permission_denied before anything executes. Preflight checks every item before any item runs, with no rollback; items then execute one at a time. Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-shelve audit reports auditRecorded=false and stays a success. D28 ignition-null-v1 encodes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}. D10: the documented default batch is 20 items and the hard maximum is 100. Example: {"paths":["prov:default:/tag:AHU/AHU01:/alm:HighSetpoint"],"timeoutSeconds":3600}.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: 1..100 exact Alarm paths. Provider-qualified with no wildcard, for example prov:default:/tag:Folder/Tag:/alm:AlarmName. Default 20 (D10), hard maximum 100.

parameters.name: timeoutSeconds
parameters.description: Shelve duration in seconds. Required, 1..86400; the Runtime Target Policy may lower the effective maximum.
